You can open the site on admin01 at `http://10.0.2.15/` (or `http://admin01/` if that hostname resolves from your client). I verified the HTTP response from admin01 itself; I did not click the button in a browser, but the served HTML contains the click handler that sets the greeting to `Hello, David!`.
